_comment: THE TWO REGISTERED ENTITIES AND THE THREE TRADING NAMES THEY OPERATE UNDER. Every course in this registry belongs to exactly one provider and, for ACI, exactly one trading-name variant. Identity strings are NOT copied here - they live in the assessment skill's branding profiles and are named below, because two copies of an address are two addresses free to drift apart.

MVC.legalEntity: Golden Wattle Group Pty Ltd T/A Meridian Vocational College
MVC._variantsComment: MVC trades under one name. There is nothing to resolve.

ACI._tradingNameComment: DELIBERATELY NULL. ACI is one registered entity trading under two names, and the name a document carries is decided by the VOCATION OF THE UNIT, never by anything a user types. Read the variant, never this field.

construction._packagesComment: CPC alone is NOT enough. Adelaide Construction Institute delivers MSF30322 Certificate III in Cabinet Making and Timber Technology, whose units carry MSF, MSM and BSB prefixes. The assessment skill's Resolve-BrandVariant maps CPC only and THROWS on an MSF unit - see openItems in assets/courses/ACI-MSF30322.json. Recorded here as the correct mapping.
construction.vocation: Construction, building, cabinet making and timber technology

variantResolution._ambiguousComment: A BSB unit takes the variant of the COURSE it is being built for, which the course record states. Where a BSB unit is requested with no course, ASK. Never guess a trading name.

sharedUnitPolicy._comment: A unit of competency is national and identical wherever it is delivered. What differs between courses is WHAT IS TAUGHT INSIDE IT - the topic allocation - because the same unit sits in a different neighbourhood of sibling units in each course.
sharedUnitPolicy._allocationComment: SITXFSA005 in SIT30821 owns food-safety topics outright. The SAME unit in SIT50422 owns almost none of them, because SIT50422 learners arrive holding SIT30821. Never read a topic allocation without its course.
